meaning:
A man of the Moabites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.3.4
§ Mesha = "deliverance"
the king of Moab in the time of Ahab and Jehoram

elsewhere.note: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with the wool of one hundred thousand lambs, and of one hundred thousand rams.
